integrity: The eight-file frozen proof package was read, its Git tree reconstructed, and the generator, conditional-variance, rigidity and sharp support-envelope arguments rederived. Independent symbolic checks corroborate the algebra. The 2017 same-object bifurcation article was inspected in accessible full author text; the 2021 complete-phase-portrait abstract was compared but full text remained inaccessible via lawful routes. The classical equilibrium discriminant is attributed to the earlier literature.
scientific_limitations: Only compact measures supported strictly inside the positive quadrant are covered; no invariant distributions that approach or touch v=0 are included.
SymPy checks are finite algebraic corroboration, not a proof of conditional-measure stationarity or all-parameter dynamics.
The result does not describe noncompact or spatially inhomogeneous dynamics.

Full 2021 Chen–Li–Llibre 32-page phase-portrait postprint was not read; repository route failed and authorized institutional service returned vpn_disconnected. Its geometric classification might imply the support envelope; no blanket NOT_COVERING inference.
The conditional-generator identities and variance decompositions use classical general facts; an unindexed Gray–Scott-specific weighted stationary identity may exist.
Search negatives alone cannot guarantee historical priority; no new claim about discovery of the classical fold curve or equilibrium branches.
title: Dual stationary nullcline calibration and activity defects in the Gray–Scott kinetics
